title: The fake L9 incident document
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: there was actually a fake >> document created called the L9 incident at Ellsworth Air Force Base, which was a day before Michael and Mario's experience

plain: In November 1977 someone created a fake document describing an "L9 incident" at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, dated a day before two men, Michael and Mario, had their own experience there. Michels says this himself and links the fake to a man named Richard Doty. If it is true, a false record was planted right next to a real event, maybe to muddy it.
